name: Whisperer
body:
Prerequisite(s) know at least 3 Modifying Words, Words of Foundation class feature Through extreme mastery of Foundation, you have discovered the secret to sharing your knowledge temporarily.

Benefit(s): Once per day as a full-round action you may whisper a Word of Foundation and Identifying Word into an ally’s ear. Doing this expends a use of the Identifying Word and the Word itself, as well as requiring you to gain any penalties associated with speaking the Word.

That ally may use that Word and Identifying Word once as a standard action using your level and DC for the ability at the time that the Word was whispered to them. They lose this ability the next time you meditate to regain Words.

Speaker: A Pathfinder 1e class designed for use in the Lost Lands, © 2021, Michael Mars, Author Michael Mars Russell
